THE GAP IS ALREADY TOTAL AND THERE IS NOWHERE TO SEED IT. The row is classified

tree is under `specs/.history`, which is append-only and must not be mutated
even in a copy. The cost of removing this row is therefore already paid in full
and no mutant is needed to price it -- but it is named, because a row that
vanishes silently from a removal table is how a denominator shrinks.

SM-GM-I1-the-cited-demonstration-node-is.claims_to_catch: `complexity-ledger` -- one of the twelve `expect_exit = 0` slots AND one of the two whose failing.nodes == passing.nodes
SM-GM-I1-the-cited-demonstration-node-is.gap:
THE EXACT HOLE FI-06 NAMED, MADE EXECUTABLE. `demonstrate.py:165-176` compares
only the observed exit code, and pytest exits 0 for a passing run AND for a run
whose items were all collected and then skipped. So a demonstration whose cited
node stops actually asserting anything keeps reporting `ok`, and the registry's
count keeps reading as coverage.

TWO SKIP SHAPES, SEEDED SEPARATELY AND ON PURPOSE. This row uses `pytestmark`,
which collects the items and skips them -- pytest exits 0. `SM-GM-I6` uses
`allow_module_level=True`, which collects nothing -- pytest exits 5. If the
first survives and the second dies, then FI-06's sentence is right about the
mechanism and imprecise about its reach, and SM-03 needs to know which because
one shape is a real blind spot and the other is not. That distinction was NOT
in the finding; it came out of a synthetic exercise of this runner before any
real mutant was measured, and it is written down here rather than discovered
later next to a number.

Note this is also invisible to a full-suite run: a skip is not a failure, so
`pytest tests -q` stays green either way.

SM-GM-I2-the-demonstrated-instrument-sto.claims_to_catch: `complexity-ledger` -- the same row, on its other half: the INSTRUMENT going soft rather than the demonstration going quiet
SM-GM-I2-the-demonstrated-instrument-sto.gap:
THE HALF OF THE ROW THAT MIGHT NOT BE HOLLOW. `scripts/complexity_ledger.py`
refuses a close by returning verdict `rejected`; this mutant makes it record
every close instead. If the row catches this, `expect_exit = 0` was carrying
real information after all -- it asserts that the node which demonstrates the
refusal still passes -- and the correct SM-03 verdict is REPAIR, not DELETE.
Seeded so that "hollow" is measured rather than inherited from a headline.

SM-GM-I3-an-instrument-that-was-never-ad.claims_to_catch: `test_the_named_instruments_are_all_enumerated` -- the check that is supposed to keep the registry honest
SM-GM-I3-an-instrument-that-was-never-ad.gap:
`required <= enumerated` IS ONE-DIRECTIONAL. A new instrument is not in
`required`, so the subset relation stays true whether or not it was registered.
The test's own docstring concedes it (`FI-04-DF-04`, confirmed three times), and
FI-04 shipped `divergence.py` with the suite fully green and the row absent.
This mutant adds a file that is an instrument by every criterion the registry
uses -- executable, under a declared root, argparse, a nonzero exit path -- and
registers nothing. If it survives, SM-03's repair has a demonstrated failing
input to build against; if the repair works, this same row flips to DIES.

SM-GM-I4-a-shipped-spec-yaml-is-committe.claims_to_catch: `spec-yaml-tripwire`, classified `no-demonstration-constructible` -- 'NOT WITHOUT BREAKING A SHIPPED FILE'
SM-GM-I4-a-shipped-spec-yaml-is-committe.gap:
THE REASON MAY BE ABOUT THE RUNNER, NOT THE INSTRUMENT. Four registry rows are
declared unconstructible because a demonstration would have to break a shipped
file -- but `demonstrate.py:150-162` runs every pytest slot against REPO_ROOT
rather than against the staged tree it just built, so breaking a shipped file is
exactly what it cannot do. This mutant breaks one in a THROWAWAY tree. If the
tripwire goes red, the demonstration is constructible and the four rows'
declared reason is a property of the runner; if it does not, the rows are right
and the reason stands as written. Either answer is worth having before SM-03
deletes on the strength of it.

`specs/results/deferred_findings_hexagonal_prompting.yaml` is chosen because it
is a sealed archive leaf: nothing loads it at import time, so a red here is the
tripwire's doing and not a cascade.

SM-GM-I5-the-enumerator-itself-stops-rep.claims_to_catch: nothing that has ever been named -- `demonstrate.py` is the enumerator and is ABSENT FROM ITS OWN REGISTRY
SM-GM-I5-the-enumerator-itself-stops-rep.gap:
THE INSTRUMENT THAT COUNTS THE INSTRUMENTS. `demonstrate.py:301` is
`return 1 if failures else 0` and that exit code is its entire verdict surface.
This mutant makes it always return 0. `test_every_fast_demonstration_reproduces`
asserts `returncode == 0` AND the string 'Every declared demonstration
reproduced.' -- and the string is printed by `render()` from the same `failures`
list, so a mutant that only softens the EXIT leaves the assertion satisfied.

If this survives, then every count SM-03 is about to report -- 40 enumerated, 35
instruments, 26 with a demonstrated failing input -- comes from a program whose
own verdict nothing watches, and `denominator_rule` has to be applied to the
enumerator before it is applied to the enumerated.

SM-GM-I6-the-cited-demonstration-node-is.claims_to_catch: `complexity-ledger` -- the same row, against the OTHER skip shape
SM-GM-I6-the-cited-demonstration-node-is.gap:
THE CONTRAST ROW FOR SM-GM-I1, and it is here so that a survival there cannot be
explained away as 'skips are just invisible'. `pytest.skip(allow_module_level=
True)` collects nothing, and pytest's exit code for that is 5, not 0 -- so
`expect_exit = 0` should catch it. A pair that only ever seeded one skip shape
would license a conclusion about both.

It is also the sharper reading of the registry's blind spot: the twelve slots
are blind to a demonstration that goes VACUOUS, not to one that disappears.

THE FAR SIDE OF `ledger.LedgerAppendPort`. Ordering, not content: PA-M11/PA-M12

SM-GM-P3-the-fake-is-silently-a-second-r.gap:
THE SWAP'S OWN PREMISE. `[ports.*]`'s `fake =` key names a second
implementation; if that implementation is the first one under another name,
`--wiring fake` produces a column that looks independent and is not. This is
the fault a swap mechanism exists to make impossible, so if the machinery is
load-bearing anywhere it is load-bearing here.
